programme.desc: Fred, Jamy et Sabine nous expliquent les règles d'or d'une alimentation équilibrée. Trop de gras et pas assez de vitamines ? Beaucoup de sucreries et le moins de légumes possible ! Voici des cocktails redoutables pour la santé ! Mal manger peut entraîner des maladies graves et favoriser l'obésité. Sabine nous offre un petit éclaircissement sur les aliments qui nous font du bien. Pourquoi faut-il manger ? A quoi servent les lipides, les glucides et les protides ? Dans quelle mesure sont-ils bons pour le corps ? Comment notre appareil digestif fonctionne-t-il ? Comment les nutriments sont-ils dirigés vers les cellules de notre organisme ? Pourquoi grossit-on ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Cette semaine, Fred, Jamy et Sabine nous expliquent tout sur l’histoire des Gaulois, depuis leurs origines celtes jusqu'à la conquête de la Gaule par Jules César. A travers une reconstitution historique, ils nous racontent leur vie quotidienne, leurs pratiques religieuses, leur organisation politique... A quelle période apparaissent les Gaulois ? Où vivaient-ils ? La Gaulle était composée de différents peuples. Comment était-elle organisée politiquement ? Avant l’invasion romaine, quelles sont les relations entre les gaulois et les romains ? Comment étaient organisées les villes gauloises, qu’on appelait alors des oppida ? Comment et pourquoi Jules César a-t-il conquis la Gaule ? Comment César a-t-il vaincu Vercongétorix à Alésia ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Minérales, de source ou du robinet... quelles routes les eaux que nous consommons empruntent-elles avant d'atterrir dans nos verres ? Quels filtres naturels vont agir sur l'eau de pluie pour la transformer en une eau parfaitement pure ? Comment cette eau se charge-t-elle en minéraux ? Quels sont les effets de ces minuscules composants sur notre corps ? D'où vient le gaz carbonique qui fait pétiller les eaux qu'on dit gazeuses ? Fred et Jamy sont remontés à la source des eaux minérales. Ils sont en Auvergne et nous expliquent tout de la manière dont on capte et contrôle ces eaux d'origine atmosphérique.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: La toute première photo a été prise en 1822 par le Français Nicéphore Niepce. A l'époque, la surface sensible était une plaque de bitume qui réagissait à la lumière. Et en 1888, est apparue la première pellicule. Une pellicule que l'on développe en la plongeant dans une série bains chimiques... Aujourd'hui, c'est un petit rectangle parsemé de cellules électriques réagissant à la lumière qui l'a remplacée. La photo numérique est née, et elle a envahi le marché ! Fred et Jamy se sont improvisés photographes reporters sur une épreuve de descente de la coupe du monde de ski alpin. Ils sont à Val d'Isère, et nous expliquent tout sur cette photographie d'un âge nouveau.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy sont partis explorer les glaciers les plus grandioses du massif alpin pour tenter de comprendre avec nous pourquoi la plupart des glaciers de la planète se mettent à reculer. Après un magnifique survol des glaciers alpins en hélicoptère, ils nous offrent une plongée dans cet univers de neige et de glace en compagnie de guides de haute montagne et de glaciologues. De crevasses en moraines, de séracs en lacs pro glaciaires, ils nous expliquent comment un glacier naît, vit... et meurt. Découvrant qu'en un siècle et demi la spectaculaire mer de glace a perdu pas moins de 100 mètres d'épaisseur, il est à parier que ce numéro de C'est pas sorcier ne vous laissera pas de glace !

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Figuiers de barbarie, « coussins de belle-mère », cactus raquette, cactus cierge… La famille des cactus compte plus de 2000 espèces. Originaire des régions arides d’Amérique latine, ces drôles de végétaux sont particulièrement bien adaptés à la sécheresse. Certaines espèces peuvent même vivre sans une goutte de pluie pendant plusieurs années ! Sabine et Jamy sont partis dans le sud de la France, et nous expliquent tout sur la biologie de ces plantes si particulières. Croissance, reproduction, culture, méthodes d’arrosage ou utilité des épines… Les cactus n’aurons plus aucun secret pour vous

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Les meilleurs chiens de la gendarmerie nationale ont un flair extraordinaire pour retrouver des armes, de la drogue, des personnes disparues ou de l'argent. Mais ils n'ont pas appris cela tous seuls. Avec Fred, qui est allé les rencontrer dans leur école, à Gramat, dans le Lot, nous travaillerons sur une scène de crime, puis nous reconstituerons la disparition d'un adolescent. Avec Jamy, nous ferons connaissance d'un chien docteur, puis d'un autre aux étonnantes capacités mentales d'abstraction. Bienvenu dans le monde des experts.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Les avions se cacheraient-ils pour mourir ? Ils finissent leur existence loin de nos yeux, dans les déserts américains ou de petits aéroports Français hors des grands terminaux internationaux. C'est à l'aéroport de Châteauroux, à l'occasion de la mise à mort d'un de ces géants des airs, le fameux 747, que nous allons décortiquer le fonctionnement du recyclage des avions, une activité naissante qui croit aujourd'hui avec la demande de plus en plus importante de récupération et de recyclage du matériel et des matériaux aéronautiques si coûteux.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Les grottes sont intimement liées à l’histoire de nos rivières : tandis que celles-ci creusent leur lit et s’enfoncent dans les vallées, les galeries souterraines se mettent doucement à plonger vers les entrailles de la Terre, grignotant la roche toujours plus profondément. Mais en Ardèche, rien ne semble s’être passé ainsi : les grottes sont d’abord apparues dans les profondeurs et ont ensuite gagné du terrain en remontant vers la surface. Les rivières de la région se seraient-elles élevées dans les vallées, jouant ainsi les filles de l’air ? Comment un scénario pareil aurait-il pu se produire ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Libération d’otages, lutte contre la piraterie, soutien des troupes aux sols. Leurs actions sont déterminantes. Mais qui sont ces hommes de l’ombre qui agissent dans la plus grande discrétion ? Fred et Jamy nous plongent dans les coulisses des commandos marines et de leurs « opérations spéciales ». Exceptionnellement, Fred a été autorisé à participer à l’entrainement de ce corps d’élite, basés à Lorient et Toulon. Pour commencer, Fred devra faire le redoutable parcours commando destiné à tester les aptitudes physiques des candidats qui doivent être capables de se déplacer aussi bien dans les airs qu’en pleine mer. Pendant ce temps, au repos dans son camion-laboratoire, Jamy nous rappelle que ces hommes sont avant tout des militaires et que leurs actions ont lieu en dehors de la France à la différence du RAID ou du GIGN

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Depuis janvier, le ZooParc de Beauval accueille deux pensionnaires d’exception : des pandas géants, originaires de Chine. Ce sont les seuls visibles en France ! Fred a été autorisé exceptionnellement à participer aux soins quotidiens qu’ils reçoivent. Jamy, lui, s’est rendu dans une bambouseraie qui fournit une grande partie de l’alimentation des deux ours chinois.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Sabine a partagé le quotidien d’Elsa, dont la maladie a été diagnostiquée il y a 4 ans. Si Elsa est capable de jouer sans partition un morceau de piano appris dans son enfance, ou de se rappeler de souvenirs très anciens, Elsa a en revanche des difficultés à se souvenir de ce qu'elle a fait la veille. Les séances d'orthophonie ralentissent les effets de cette maladie, tandis que les visites au Louvre avec un groupe de malades lui permettent de garder confiance en elle, et de rester dans la communication.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Il n’est pas plus gros que le poing, mais il nous maintient en vie grâce à ses battements réguliers… Le cœur est une extraordinaire machine essentielle à l’ensemble de notre organisme. Chaque jour, 100 000 battements cardiaques envoient l’équivalent de 8000 litres de sang dans notre organisme ! Mais notre cœur est aussi particulièrement vulnérable… Chaque année, en France, 40 000 personnes sont ainsi victimes d’arrêts cardiaques et meurent subitement. Pour découvrir comment fonctionne notre cœur et apprendre à faire face à la crise, Fred se rend à Montpellier, à la rencontre de sportifs, de cardiologues et de patients – tous unis par une même préoccupation : préserver l’intégrité du « palpitant ». Jamy va quant à lui installer son laboratoire au Centre de Recherche Cardiovasculaire, à l’hôpital européen George Pompidou.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Dans un laboratoire de neurosciences de l'Université Paris -Descartes, Fred participe à des tests en réalité virtuelle pour évaluer ses mémoires à court terme et la consolidation de ses souvenirs. Jamy nous explique pourquoi et comment certains événements de notre vie s'oublient très vite, alors que d'autres restent gravés à jamais.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Sébastien le Pestre de Vauban était commissaire aux fortifications au temps de Louis XIV. Partout autour des frontières françaises, il fit protéger les villes en y construisant des remparts aux formes curieuses. Fred et Jamy partent explorer les constructions de ce brillant ingénieur, qui fut à la fois un architecte talentueux et un fin stratège militaire.Mission Fred est parti à la découverte de l'une des plus belles places fortifiées construites par Vauban : celle de Saint-Martin de Ré, sur l'île de Ré. Glacis, chemins couverts et passages secrets... il explore les remparts dans leurs moindres détails pour nous raconter comment on défendait ces citadelles sous Louis XIV. Nous le retrouvons tout près de l'île d'Oléron, au fort de Chapus. Là, il nous explique comment Vauban a assuré la défense du littoral charentais en construisant en pleine mer, dans des conditions particulièrement difficiles, des petits forts destinés à barrer le passage aux bateaux ennemis.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Maison de paille, maison de bois, maison de brique…? Cette semaine, C'est pas sorcier nous rejoue la fable des trois petits cochons dans sa version écologique ! Avec la complicité de Sabine et Jamy, nous découvrons mille astuces qui permettent non seulement d'économiser de l'énergie avec sa maison, mais qui offrent aussi le luxe inouï de vivre dans un environnement sain et peu polluant. Car souvenez-vous, juste après les transports, ce sont nos logements qui polluent le plus !

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Des protons lancés à près de 300 000 km par seconde dans de longs tuyaux enfouis sous la terre ? La drôle de machine qui réalise cet exploit atteint 27 kilomètres de circonférence et traverse la frontière franco-suisse de part en part. Elle devrait bientôt nous permettre d'en savoir plus sur la matière qui constitue notre Univers. Fred et Jamy sont partis découvrir le plus grand collisionneur de particules du monde. Entre protons, neutrons, quarks et gluons... ils plongent dans l'univers de l'infiniment petit et nous livrent les secrets de tous ces minuscules grains de matières qui nous composent.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Et si l'hydrogène était l'énergie du futur ? Aux quatre coins de la planète, on planche sur cette source d'énergie prometteuse… Il faut dire que ce gaz a de sérieux atouts : combiné à l'oxygène, il libère beaucoup d'énergie… et ne rejette que de l'eau. Pas une trace de ce fameux CO2 qui pose tant de problèmes à notre planète ! Seuls hics à ce qui pourrait être un véritable conte de fée écologique : ce gaz est difficile à stocker, terriblement explosif, et sa production reste encore très gourmande en énergie. Fred et Jamy nous offrent un tour d'horizon de toutes les avancées technologiques qui feront peut-être de l'hydrogène… l'énergie de demain !

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Pourquoi le lait est-il blanc ? Pourquoi y a-t-il des trous dans le gruyère ? Et pourquoi bat-on le lait pour en faire du beurre ? Fred, Jamy et Sabine nous expliquent tout sur le lait et les produits laitiers. Nous découvrons avec eux l'art de battre, de fouetter, de broyer le lait pour en obtenir un beurre jaune et délicat ou de délicieux fromages...

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Trisha, a mother and wife, who is live streaming her entire life. Trisha claims she’s been bullied and harassed by her online “haters.” But Wendy, one of the women Trisha calls a “hater,” says it’s Trisha who has ruined people’s lives by live streaming their personal information, making negative comments about their appearance, and even claiming they are convicts. Find out what caused Trisha to storm off and collapse on stage. And, why did Dr. Phil almost have to call the paramedics?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil addresses Cindy's impact on Tecoa's sobriety and reunites Sarah and Tecoa with their estranged father.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Revisiting the 1992 murder of Shanda Sharer, her family reflects on coping and forgiveness.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of Shanda Sharer who was murdered confronts one of the convicted killers.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happened to the victims of self-proclaimed FLDS prophet, Warren Jeffs?

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's been weeks since Brandon's intervention and reluctant agreement to check into a drug treatment facility. Now, he and his family speak with Dr. Phil as they start the lifelong marathon of recovery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a three-part series, a man makes a shocking confession to his wife, only after he failed a polygraph test.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part two, Dr. Phil continues working with a couple who are struggling to stay together after the husband’s shocking confession.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part 3, what started out as a husband’s admitting to a sex addiction turned into a shocking story of murder.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Fifteen-year-old Madisen says she wants desperately for a place to belong and has made terrible choices in an attempt to do just that. She claims to have already joined a gang, gotten pregnant and hit a teacher. Everyone, even Madisen, agrees she is troubled, but why does Dr. Phil say it would’ve been a bigger surprise if she didn't turn out this way? Did her father really try to forfeit his parental rights? And did her mother turn a blind eye to so many red flags? Learn why Dr. Phil believes it’s not too late for this teen.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Madisen first appeared on Dr. Phil her family had reached a breaking point with her defiant and outrageous behavior. Months later, after completing her program at a residential treatment facility for troubled teens, Madisen returns to the Dr. Phil stage to show off her amazing transformation. The 15-year-old says she’s ready to return home, but is home ready for her?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge on committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live in fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Chrystel says she feels rage and snaps and then it gets to the point where there's no return. Jessica says her fits of rage become so intense, she's scared that she will hurt her son. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil once again exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge of committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live with the fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Joanna says her rage is scaring her son. Michelle’s rage has driven her to slap her child and hit her with a wooden spoon. Lisa admits to pulling her daughter’s hair when she gets angry. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A man accuses his ex-wife and her new husband of killing his children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Tommy, who accuses his ex-wife, Julia, and her new husband, Codey, of killing his 19-month-old son, Darby, and 4-year-old stepdaughter, Kiera -- an allegation the couple vehemently deny. Dr. Phil enlists the help of forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht to examine the children’s autopsy reports -- what are his findings? And, will Julia and Codey agree to take polygraph tests?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Anthony says he fears his 29-year-old brother, Jamie, a fitness model and personal trainer, won’t live to see 30 if he doesn’t get serious help with his addictions. She says he lied about how many times he’d been married, and when she discovered he was registered on a singles dating site, he told her that he was doing research for a friend! She says she’s also suspicious of her spouse’s low sex drive and fears he may be getting his needs met elsewhere. Hermann says he wants to regain his wife’s trust but says he can’t handle her insecurity. Should Tingle give him another chance or kick him to the curb? And, when Elizabeth was last on the show, she wanted to know once and for all if her husband, Shawn, was being unfaithful. The man even followed Tony’s family when they moved to a new state, and he eventually abducted Tony. Authorities say they believe he had a sinister and dark plan for the little boy. Today, Tony speaks out for the first time about what happened to him.

programme.title: European Pickleball Championship
programme.desc: The 2025 European Pickleball Championships in Rome, Italy, hosts the high-stakes Women's Doubles Open Final featuring Team England against Team Spain. Defending champions Spain, represented by the powerhouse duo of Sabrina Mendez and Glauka Carvajal, look to secure their second consecutive title against the English pair of Thaddea Lock and Katy Morris.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: We are live in sunny San Diego for Week 3 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025. This high-stakes collegiate team match features the University of San Diego (USD) battling Grand Canyon University (GCU) in a best-of-seven series.The action includes intense Men's Doubles , Women's Singles , and Mixed Doubles as these teams compete for regional dominance. Watch top talent, including GCU's lefty powerhouse Adam Jones, who boasts a strong 5.6 singles rating , and his partner Xavier Cook Nakakuki. On the USD side, the episode highlights the partnership of Marcus Hopkins and Ryan, an impressive grad student player with high doubles ratings. USD’s Bella also shows grit in the women's singles match. This broadcast captures the best of college pickleball in an amazing format.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the final showdown of the league stages as Delhi Dilwale and the Rajasthan Titans clash in a high-stakes battle for pride and final positioning. The atmosphere is electric as Rajasthan’s Lorena Dupnik delivers a "professional performance" in a come-from-behind singles victory against Delhi’s Mehek Kuan, setting a fierce tone for the tie. Witness a tactical masterclass in mixed doubles featuring the relentless power of Max Mantor and the "next level" skills of Trang Huynh as they attempt to dismantle the Titans’ defensive wall. With veteran Rob Cassidy making his highly anticipated men's doubles debut, every rally becomes a desperate fight for dominance in the season's final league encounter.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: October 10, 2023 - Welcome to week 3 - season 2 of The Arizona Pickleball League! It's Tuesday Night Pickleball @ The Orchard, and the Tempe Tornadoes face-off against the Surprise Stingers.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Pros vs College Allstars at the 2025 NCPA Championships from Las Vegas.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: We are live from the Barnes Tennis Center in San Diego, California, for Week 3 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025. This thrilling collegiate team match features Grand Canyon University (GCU) taking on the University of Hawaii. The broadcast picks up in the heat of the action during a crucial mixed doubles game, with GCU leading. Watch as the match extends into a dramatic Sudden Death Dreambreaker (Game 7) to decide the winner. The episode highlights the unique collegiate format where every point counts towards seeding for the National Championship. Key players include Hawaii's Tristan Simmons and Tama, battling against GCU's Tanner and Hannah. The match concludes with a high-stakes finish that determines who moves forward in bracket play.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 16 slams into Denver with the Welterweight World Title fight, the Heavyweight Contender Tournament, and the debut of USA Martial Arts sensation Pat Barry. Belgian striker Marc de Bonte will battle Armenia's technical machine Karapet Karapetyan for the vacant GLORY Welterweight World Title, guaranteeing a fast, explosive war. At the heaviest end of the GLORY ranks, the big-boys are set to battle it out for a higher ranked spot in the Heavyweight division, and a chance to fight for the Title later within the year. The lineup pits Errol "The Bonecrusher" Zimmerman versus "Bangin" Ben Edwards in a semi-final, and Sergei "The Paratrooper" Kharitonov vs. Anderson "Braddock" Silva in another semi-final. The tournament winner will have to win two fights in one night to claim the prize, and the right to fight for a bigger prize later in the year. Also at Heavyweight, in a tournament reserve match, MMA veteran Pat "HD" Barry returns to his original love of kickboxing, facing another GLORY debutant in the shape of Zack "The Black Warrior" Mwekassa.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: On the preliminary card, a 4-Man Featherweight Contender Tournament and other one-off bouts were featured.Mirko Cro Cop was first scheduled to face Pat Barry, and later Sergei Kharitonov on this card. However, on May 21, it was announced that Kharitonov had to withdraw from the fight due to injury. He was replaced by Jarrell Miller.Miguel Torres was scheduled to make his GLORY debut as a participant of the Featherweight tournament. However, on May 28, it was revealed he pulled out of the tournament for undisclosed reasons. He was replaced by Marcus Vinicius.

programme.title: ALCOHOL - THE MAGIC POTION
programme.desc: Alcohol is the world’s most powerful drug. Four billion people drink it regularly and the number is rising. Of the world’s 30 countries with the highest per capita alcohol consumption, no fewer than 26 are in Europe. Big business with 3 million victims each year. But who profits from all this?

programme.title: BREAD. AN EVERYDAY MIRACLE
programme.desc: Bread is a branded product with an endless number of varieties and providers. But do we actually know what we eat every day? We meet small craft bakers who stand up for their quality and we meet CEOs who work on bread as an industrial mass product which becomes increasingly artificial. How can traditional bakery skills survive? And how will the future of bread look like?

programme.title: SHARING THE HARVEST
programme.desc: SHARING THE HARVEST follows farmers who reject conventional agriculture's growth pressures. Filmmaker Philipp Petruch explores three solidarity farming initiatives aiming to build sustainable, community-supported food systems. Through community, courage, and a new consumer-producer relationship, they show how we can transform agriculture - and the world.

programme.title: JUST MOVE! ENDING THE COUCH POTATO PANDEMIC
programme.desc: Lack of physical activity is a growing problem, with over 50% of adults and 80% of young people in high-income countries being insufficiently active. The documentary JUST MOVE! ENDING THE COUCH POTATO PANDEMIC shows how we can reignite the desire for movement and overcome inactivity.

programme.title: VERY SENIOR - ATTITUDE IS EVERYTHING
programme.desc: In Sun City, the retirement community in Arizona, the residents show us how to make the best of life when death casts its shadow in old age – with attitude!

programme.title: Sex Talk
programme.desc: We discuss how new parents can fuel their love life. Plus, ways to get more creative during foreplay. These topics and more on Sex Talk with Dr. Lia.

programme.title: Sex Talk
programme.desc: How often do men really think about sex? Plus, we talk about ways to maintain intimacy when you're both the caretaker and the lover.

programme.title: Sex Talk
programme.desc: Alcohol may help get you in the mood but how does it affect your sex life? And do men fake orgasms? All this and more on Sex Talk with Dr. Lia.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr Jill Bolte Taylor, a Harvard-trained and published neuroanatomist. She shares with us the idea of cellular circuitry and how there are four distinct modules of cells that make up who we are, combining the thinking mind and the emotional side. She discusses her new book, Whole Brain Living: The Anatomy of Choice and the Four Characteristics that Drive Our Life.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Professor Robert Thurman, the preeminent scholar and interpreter of Tibetan Buddhist philosophy for the modern world, who believes that Wisdom is Bliss and in fact, that’s the name of his latest book. Thurman is a very close friend of HH Dalai Lama and today he discusses deep ideas about mindfulness and presence and leads us on a joyful exploration into the nature of reality through Buddha’s threefold curriculum.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. Harley Rotbart, a nationally renowned infectious diseases specialist, pediatrician, parenting expert, speaker, and educator who discusses his latest book No Regrets Parenting: Turning Long Days and Short Years into Cherished Moments with Your Kids. He shares special keys for parents to guide children to live a life of wonder and contentment by conscious parenting.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews marital and family psychologist Dr. Michael Tobin who believes the secret to a happy, long-lasting relationship is mutual respect for one another. He’s been with his life partner, soulmate, and wife, Deborah, for 47 years, and in practice as a psychologist for more than 45 years. His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: Why has infertility become so normal? Better yet – why are women the only one’s taking on the burden of infertility? The statistics on the amount of women struggling with PCOS (making them infertile) are only rising and with men being responsible for 50% of infertility, the conversation needs to change.

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: What if the key to a vibrant, healthy life lies in returning to our ancestral roots? In this episode of Rooted in Wellness, I’m joined by Dr. Darshan Shah who works to merge ancient healing practices with modern-day science to help his patients extend both their lifespan and more importantly, their healthspan.

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: Between work, family, and wellness, many women feel like they're running on empty. Mona shares empowering tools and mindset shifts to help women balance it all—without burning out. Fulfillment is possible when you root into what matters.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani
programme.desc: In this course, Anita Moorjani guides you toward loving yourself as if your life depends on it – because it does! When love (rather than fear) determines your life, you will recognize what is truly important for you to be happy and healthy.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani
programme.desc: Today, Anita shares what her near-death experience taught her about how to live. You’ll discover why everything we have learned through our education system, government, mass media, etc. is the exact opposite of what we should know in order to create a meaningful, joy-filled life.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani
programme.desc: Today, we take a close look at who we really are in order to recognize our purpose, understand our intentions, and recognize our true worth in this world.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani
programme.desc: We live in a fear-based world. In today’s lesson, Anita offers you tools that have been specially created to overcome your fears with love. This is the greatest lesson she learned during her near-death experience when she traveled to the other side. It’s the lesson that saved her life.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani
programme.desc: Today’s meditation will guide you through forgiveness. Of letting go of obstacles and fears that hold you back from living the life you desire to live. By doing so, you’ll be able to forgive everyone who has hurt you in this life, release emotional baggage that may be weighing heavy on you, and step into a new realm of possibility.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Day one explores core teachings from A Course in Miracles: releasing ambition, ego, and grandiosity to become a compassionate presence. Rather than fixing or leading, we learn to hold space, trust divine guidance, and allow true healing and spiritual transmission to unfold.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Day 2 of Teaching the Teachers explores the core teaching that only love is real and fear is illusion. Not a religion, the Course offers a non-dogmatic spiritual path that can complement other teachings and invites surrender to a higher power for true healing.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Day Three of Teaching the Teachers reveals that the ego conceals our perfect, God-created Self. We are not our bodies, and life continues beyond birth and death. Thoughts create effects, yet through atonement we can be freed from guilt, fear, and suffering when we choose healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programme.title: Bondi Vet

programme.title: Australia's Cheapest Weddings
